CustomField.label: Modified Since Approval
CustomField.description: Set true by RES_Payment_Plan_Before_Save_Edit_Lock whenever a business field changes (or a bundle/pricing related record changes) while RES_Approval_Status__c is Approved - drives the Submit for Approval button's visibility so it only reappears on an Approved plan once it has actually been touched. Reset to false by RES_Autolaunched_Update_Payment_Plan_Approval_Status on every approval-stage transition.
